classification: Advanced decision-intelligence prototype with a functional deterministic public Lab and an external, non-embedded private-product boundary
disclaimer: Illustrative, evidence-bounded valuation analysis. It is not an appraisal, investment advice, a financing offer, or a prediction.

headlineStages.label: Current economic / IP value
headlineStages.condition: Existing reusable code, product design, taxonomy and documentation

headlineStages.label: Validated MVP
headlineStages.condition: Measured user value, repeat use and benchmarked quality

headlineStages.label: First paying customer
headlineStages.condition: Paid institutional contract and repeatable delivery

headlineStages.label: Initial product-market fit
headlineStages.condition: $2m-$5m ARR, GRR >90%, NRR >105% and repeatable acquisition

evidence.detail: Institutional site, deterministic Lab, 6-12 synthetic opportunities, comparison, exports and human review controls.
14 deterministic public models and lenses in code, with explicit assumptions and limitations.
Only aggregate documentation of 1,970 profiles across 51 domains remains public; individual profiles are not embedded or validated here.
The public repository fails closed and requires a separately governed private runtime for any specialist execution.
Visible WBS, PERT, critical path, Monte Carlo, cost decomposition and readiness using synthetic planning assumptions.
No operational multi-tenant mission, evidence, decision or durable audit backend is connected.
No repository evidence of customers, pilots, revenue, ARR, retention, contracts or product-market fit.
No repository evidence of patents, exclusive datasets, historical outcome calibration or validated data flywheel.

methods.name: Cost to recreate - current repo
methods.note: 30-55 person-months; replacement cost is not market value.

methods.name: Risk-adjusted commercial option DCF
methods.note: Limited-liability option value; raw probability-weighted project NPV is negative.

methods.name: Venture capital method
methods.note: Base pre-money after a $1m raise; highly sensitive to exit, dilution and return hurdle.

methods.name: Correlation-haircut SOTP
methods.note: Avoids adding correlated product, method and option values at face value.

methods.name: Stage / financing reference
methods.note: Negotiated pre-money range, not intrinsic value.

stages.evidenceRequired: Coherent thesis and defensible product boundary
Working reproducible workflow and visible limitations
Bounded preview workflows; the private catalog and executor remain external
One complete workflow, durable records, evals and usage metering
Measured time saved, quality gain, repeat use and WTP
Named buyer, paid scope, security review and success metrics
Signed contract and repeatable delivery without founder-only effort
Recurring software revenue separated from services
Cohort retention, credible CAC and enterprise reference customers
Efficient growth, strong retention and enterprise controls
Multi-region sales, support, data governance and localization
$30m-$75m ARR, audited controls and proven cross-vertical repeatability

dcfSummary.note: The raw value includes uncommitted future burn. The commercial-option view floors failed paths at zero and must not be added to successful terminal values twice.

monteCarlo.note: Risk-adjusted economic option value, not a negotiated financing price. The mean is dominated by a small right tail and should not anchor current value.

components.name: Product
components.evidence: Broad working prototype; core enterprise workflow is not complete.

components.name: Market
components.evidence: Plausible wedge, no validated ICP or willingness to pay.

components.name: Customers
components.evidence: No evidenced users, pilots or customers.

components.name: Technology
components.evidence: Deterministic models, bounded execution and tests; limited differentiation.

components.name: Security
components.evidence: Useful request controls; no enterprise identity, RBAC or durable audit.

components.name: Team
components.evidence: No evidenced multidisciplinary operating team or delivery capacity.

components.name: Revenue
components.evidence: No evidenced recurring or services revenue.

components.name: External validation
components.evidence: No benchmark against analyst plus general AI baseline.

components.name: IP
components.evidence: Code, taxonomy and know-how exist; legal exclusivity and calibration do not.

components.name: Scalability
components.evidence: Cloud-compatible surface; no multi-tenancy, metering or operating proof.

comparables.examples: PitchBook; CB Insights; AlphaSense; Tegus / Quid

comparables.ventureGovernanceGap: No comparable data breadth, rights, customer base or distribution
comparables.implication: Complement data systems; do not claim to replace them

comparables.strength: Integrations, ontology, governance, operations and enterprise procurement maturity
comparables.ventureGovernanceGap: No multi-tenant control plane, production integrations or service history
comparables.implication: Not valuation comparables at current stage

comparables.examples: Microsoft Copilot; OpenAI API; Google Vertex AI; AWS Bedrock
comparables.strength: Low marginal model cost, distribution and developer ecosystems
comparables.ventureGovernanceGap: Generic synthesis and orchestration are easy to reproduce
Agent count and routing alone are not a moat
comparables.implication: Defend with evidence, outcomes, integrations and institutional history

comparables.examples: Strategy firms; corporate strategy; data science teams
comparables.strength: Trust, customization, domain context and accountability
comparables.ventureGovernanceGap: Current product still needs expert delivery
comparables.implication: Potential design partners and channel, not only competitors

market.recommendedWedge: CVC, venture studios and corporate innovation / investment teams

API, white label and marketplace only after stable evals, rights and demand
market.warning: All ICP filters, ACV, conversion, cycle and retention assumptions are unvalidated and must be replaced with observed funnel data.
